# `branch.get`

Show a branch

The branch target as stored. Slashed names arrive percent-encoded.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie branch get`
- MCP: `branch_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branch` | path | yes | `string` |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
